limitations: One engine-assisted reviewer used ordinary root lines and played replies. Labels were saved before any candidate output was read. Uncertainty is explicit.

cases.rationale: The king manoeuvres around the h-pawn while the rooks give checks from the side. The leading choices preserve the same drawn defensive setup.
